question: The members of a Vidhan Parishad are elected for a term of ________ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidhan Parishad members **are elected for a term of **6 years.**
 
• Vidhan Parishad is the **upper house of the State Legislature** in India, also known as the** Legislative Council.**
 
• The members of Vidhan Parishad are elected indirectly by members of **local bodies, teachers, graduates, and other professionals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **5 years** is the term for members of the **Lok Sabha**, the lower house of the Parliament of India.
 
• **5 years** is the term for members of the **State Legislative Assembly,** the lower house of the State Legislature.
